name: goshs (single-binary file server: HTTP, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP and more)
loc: Go 18.2k lines without tests (246 files in the module zip)
note: Public releases fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs from the Go module proxy (immutable zips; the canonical module path goshs.de/goshs/v2 from go.mod, also served under github.com/goshs-labs/goshs/v2 with the same files but different zip bytes). The zips' go.sum hashes were recomputed and match sum.golang.org. v2.1.4 is the vulnerable target, v2.1.5 the control; eight repository advisories are fixed between them (the two with CVEs, GHSA-964w-f6gj-5236 and GHSA-wg2q-39h6-66x9, in commit f3ef599e). Commits from the proxy .info: v2.1.4 d4e775d5, v2.1.5 3a24c85a. The release ships .claude/rules/*.md (the maintainer's agent notes); fetch.mjs removes them from app/. Many later advisories (August to October 2026) still affect v2.1.5: on the control, unmatched findings are expected and some are real.

advisories.type: ACL and block-list bypass: served file name taken from the raw request path
Path traversal: multipart upload file name not checked for a parent-directory name
Authentication bypass through an over-broad unauthenticated route exemption
no-delete and upload-only modes bypassed by overwriting existing files (HTTP and WebDAV)
upload-only mode bypassed: WebDAV POST is served like GET
FTP server ignores upload-only and only partly enforces no-delete
Share links bypass the per-directory ACL and block list
